_comment: Copy to your repository root as graph-review.config.json and replace every path below with your own. The paths here are placeholders; a self-check against them fails until they name real files. Write the usage rule into your own development rules so it binds.

budget._comment: The weekly limit is the scarce resource, so the ladder is DATA, not judgement. default MUST be cheap — the self-check refuses anything else. A full run is bought, never inherited by qualifying.

cheap.engine_2: sentinels touched by this diff only

money_review._comment: Optional. On a diff that touches money_paths each AREA is read by one `reader` agent carrying that area's charters; every charter belongs to exactly one area; findings are merged by root cause before the killers. Without this block a money diff is read by the charter fan-out.

small.readers: every area the diff touches — no touched area is left unread

full.engine_3: in full, when the diff carries a migration
full.killers: one per UNIQUE finding after the dedupe
full.second_echelon: the fix diff only, when the fix touched money (ia-money-pass 4.7)

sentinel_paths._comment: Files where WHAT NEEDS WHAT is declared. Touching any makes Engine 2 mandatory. Keep it short — forty paths means Engine 2 runs every time, which is the same as having no rule. Guarded by guards/sentinel-paths.test.ts.

money_paths._comment: Touching any of these makes a FULL run mandatory and requires executable reproduction for every breaks_money finding.

engine_3._comment: data_dump is required whenever a migration contains a repair block — a schema-only drill cannot find a repair that collides with real rows.

killer._comment: Two tiers. Tier 1 (read the code at the write anchor) runs on every finding. Tier 2 (executable reproduction) ONLY when the finding survived tier 1 AND touches a sentinel or money path — both, not either. Otherwise the kill phase eats the limit it exists to protect.

quarantine._comment: Confirmed money/sentinel findings land here as SKIPPED failing tests carrying their finding id (GR-YYYY-MM-DD-N), un-skipped in the same commit as the fix. The finding and its regression test are one artefact.

_test_command_comment: Carry the suite's own preconditions in the command. test_command_must_match is an optional regular expression the self-check requires test_command to satisfy — use it to pin a precondition (a real database, a seed) so it cannot be dropped quietly. Delete the field if you have none.
